$comment: Single source of truth for every expo-ble-kit test peripheral (Bumble, Zephyr, fake adapter). See docs/ARCHITECTURE_AND_PLAN.md §8.3 and test-peripherals/README.md.
uuidRule: Custom UUIDs replace the 0000 at characters 4-8 of uuidBase with a 16-bit id. All UUIDs are lowercase 128-bit (§4.12).
patterns: A value {"pattern": {length, multiplier, offset, modulus}} is the bytes b[i] = (i * multiplier + offset) % modulus for i in 0..length-1.

characteristics.behavior: 512-byte deterministic value, longer than any single ATT packet.
Returns the last value written to ECHO_WRITE. Empty until the first write.
Discards written bytes and adds their count to SINK_COUNTER.
Total bytes received by SINK_NO_RSP since the last RESET_COUNTERS, uint32 LE. While subscribed, notifies the new total at most every notifyIntervalMs when it changed.
Notifies frames at the rate and size set by CONTROL SET_STREAM. See stream.frame.
On CONTROL SEND_INDICATIONS(count), sends count indications one after another (each waits for its confirmation). Value: sequence number, uint32 LE, continuing across commands until RESET_COUNTERS.
Readable only over an encrypted link, so reading it triggers pairing (LE Secure Connections, Just Works, bonding).
PSM of the L2CAP LE credit-based echo server (l2cap.echo), uint16 LE.
Commands from control.commands: 1-byte opcode followed by little-endian parameters. Invalid commands fail with control.errors.

services.behavior: Absent at start. CONTROL TOGGLE_SECONDARY_SERVICE adds or removes it (always the last service in the database, so other handles never move) and sends a Service Changed indication for its handle range.
Standard Heart Rate service for demos.

characteristics.behavior: While subscribed, notifies [flags=0x00, bpm uint8] every intervalMs. bpm counts up from minBpm to maxBpm and wraps.

stream.frame: uint32 LE sequence number, then payload bytes p[j] = (seq + j) % 256 for j in 0..frameSize-5. The sequence starts at 0 and continues until RESET_COUNTERS.
stream.mtuRule: A frame larger than ATT_MTU - 3 for a subscriber is truncated to ATT_MTU - 3 for that subscriber (the sequence number is always intact).

commands.name: SET_STREAM
commands.behavior: Starts STREAM at rateHz (1..1000) with frameSize bytes per frame. rateHz 0 stops it. frameSize must be within stream.minFrameSize..maxFrameSize.

commands.name: DISCONNECT_AFTER
commands.behavior: Terminates the connection that wrote the command after delayMs (HCI reason 0x13, remote user terminated).

commands.name: TOGGLE_SECONDARY_SERVICE
commands.behavior: Adds or removes the SECONDARY service and indicates Service Changed (see services.SECONDARY).

commands.name: RESET_COUNTERS
commands.behavior: Resets SINK_COUNTER, the STREAM sequence and the INDICATE sequence to 0.

commands.name: SEND_INDICATIONS
commands.behavior: Sends count INDICATE indications to the connection that wrote the command (if it subscribed).

unknownOpcode.meaning: Opcode not in control.commands, or empty write

invalidParameters.meaning: Wrong parameter length or out-of-range value

echo.behavior: LE credit-based channel server that sends every received SDU back unchanged.
